description: This Java class defines a handler for managing database cursor operations, such as opening, closing, and fetching results, for JDBC statement objects within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CursorStatement
classes.description: A class that wraps JDBC Statement or PreparedStatement to handle cursor operations with transaction management and debugging.

methods.name: CursorStatement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cursor, begins a transaction, and manages auto-commit settings.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles method calls on the proxy, managing cursor operations like close, executeQuery, getMoreResults, and property setters/getters.

methods.name: newCursorStatement
methods.description: Creates a new cursor handler for a Statement object.

methods.name: newCursorPreparedStatement
methods.description: Creates a new cursor handler for a PreparedStatement object.
